definitions: To appear to be; to give a particular impression.
To be perceived as having a particular quality or character.
examples: She comes across as very confident.
He came across as arrogant during the meeting.
The new policy might come across as unfair.
They want to come across as approachable.
It's important how you come across as a leader.
pastTenses: came across as (simple past), has/have come across as (present perfect), come across as (past perfect)
